column1: # Guitar Rig 6 notch trajectories, 48 kHz, measured with evidence/fit/track.py (multitone, per-cycle extremes, median over cycles).
#   python3 evidence/fit/measure.py probes && python3 evidence/fit/measure.py run   (or: render, then analyse)
#   track.py gen $W/probe<secs> --secs <secs>      (268 tones, 60 Hz-12 kHz, ratio 1.02, 36 files, -36 dBFS each)
#   render_gr6.sh <p9|ss> $W/probe<secs> $W/gr/<tag> <overrides>   (grstate.py + auhost render aufx 'Ni$R' -NI- per file)
#   track.py ana $W/probe<secs> $W/gr/<tag> --lo <lo> --gain-db <gain>   (q 8, hop 16, skip 1 s, prom 3 dB)
#   p9_block_p050: p9 6 s, p=0.5, lo 300, gain -5.4
#   p9_block_p090: p9 3 s, p=0.9, lo 300, gain -5.4
#   p9_block_p100: p9 3 s, p=1.0, lo 300, gain -5.4
#   ss_off_r040: ss 14 s, Rt=0.4, lo 60, gain 0.0
#   ss_off_r050: ss 11 s, Rt=0.5, lo 60, gain 0.0
#   ss_off_r075: ss 4 s, Rt=0.75, lo 60, gain 0.0
#   ss_on_r040: ss 14 s, Rt=0.4 Cl=1, lo 60, gain 0.0
#   ss_on_r050: ss 11 s, Rt=0.5 Cl=1, lo 60, gain 0.0
#   ss_on_r075: ss 4 s, Rt=0.75 Cl=1, lo 60, gain 0.0
# Color-on additions (python3 measure.py color, after analyse): the three ss_on rows re-rendered (identical values),
#   ss_on_r000 = Rate 0 (0.01 Hz) quasi-static take through the periodic probe $W/pprobe.wav (static.py gen --secs 212),
#   analysed with static.py (5-frame average, 1.01 log grid, same notch rules), and the `static` block at the end:
#   |H| of six frozen frames (sweep bottom/top of three Sweep Min/Max windows) used by fit.py for the Color-on structure.
# Columns: depth_db = median notch-1 level; peak_db = median over frames of the highest |H| in band; peak_max_db = its maximum.
# Phaser Nine levels have its x1.862 (+5.40 dB) input make-up removed (gain_removed_db). Stoned Phaser notch 2 leaves the
# 12 kHz probe band at the sweep top, so its n2 columns are not sweep extremes. Stoned Phaser Color on: notch 1 loses
# prominence (< 3 dB) at the sweep bottom, so n1_min is the last resolved value; the period comes from notch 2 there.
